lines.text: How does a robot see? It's probably not what you think.
Put a camera on a robot, and point it at this room. We see three drones.
But the robot doesn't see drones. It sees this. Just numbers.
One HD frame is over six million numbers. At thirty frames a second, that's almost two hundred million, every second.
Somewhere in there are edges, objects, and how far away they are.
Turning those numbers into meaning? That's perception.
And a robot that can't perceive... can't act.
Fundamentals of Robot Perception. Chapter one.
